note: A3.1 — the two prefix bugs, one fixture. (a) BaseFold: `fetch(`${process.env.API_URL}/users`)` normalises to `/{}/users`; a leading interpolated segment is a base URL, not a resource, so it must be folded away before matching. Since A11.2 this tier only sees bases the repo constant table cannot resolve (an env read never resolves); a resolvable base such as `${environment.apiUrl}` is folded to its path by the engine and pairs Exact (fixture angular-base-url). (b) RoutePrefix: the old strip removed API prefixes from the ENDPOINT side only, so a client that calls `/orders` could never reach a server mounted at `/api/orders`. Both were dead cross-stack edges in every polyglot repo.

expect_nodes.name: endpoint:GET:/orders
expect_nodes.note: client is unaware of the server's /api mount
